body:
The original owner can retain **BD-Difco** continuity: its creation history identifies MediaDive1769, whose captured uses name BD-Difco; current JCM481, 482 and 612 independently name BD-Difco RCM. Prepare a supplier-qualified local identity on that authentic owner. Keep the manufacturer nine-part approximate formulation scoped to its cited product/formula; do not infer more specific peptones, salt hydrates or invariant lot composition.

The NBRC902 occurrence explicitly naming **Oxoid CM0149** needs a separate, deduplicated supplier-specific owner. Its historical formula revision is unknown. The current Oxoid IFU's formula differs from the Difco table, and must not be backdated onto that old occurrence. Bare RCM and mixed-supplier alternatives remain unresolved; preserve all raw strings/history without globally routing generic aliases to either product. Additional water, agar and sea salts in receiving media are not automatically constituents of the purchased dry product. The existing Dehydrated_RCM_Medium scope must be checked during deduplication, not silently absorbed.

Sources: [MediaDive1769](https://mediadive.dsmz.de/ingredients/1769), [JCM481](https://www.jcm.riken.jp/cgi-bin/jcm/jcm_grmd?GRMD=481), [NBRC902](https://www.nite.go.jp/nbrc/catalogue/NBRCMediumDetailServlet?NO=902), [Oxoid IFU](https://assets.thermofisher.com/TFS-Assets/MBD/Instructions/MBD_BT_IFU-0539%20CM0149B%20REINFORCED%20CLOSTRIDIAL%20MEDIUM.pdf), [Difco/BBL manual excerpt](https://cdn.media.interlabdist.com.br/uploads/2021/01/Reinforced-Clostridial-Medium.pdf).

Independent full-owner scope review is recorded in `.temp/all-unmatched-20261107/preflight/existing-owner-scope-decisions-v1/`; decisions SHA256 `150af7315aa6688d4bc9adb3e2a27d0a0835ec8f8ac33d65b8951712b0382d81`, manifest `c664e35067692c0aa46c4570ec688ffba9281e692337cfa5de1e4f014dc2ce54`. The coordinator rehashed all 89 manifest members. This is a sourced conclusion for candidate preparation; final exact candidate bytes still require native validation and independent review. No maintained records or approvals have changed.

The bounded reconciliation now has separate private candidates for the authentic
MediaDive1769 Difco owner and the catalog-qualified NBRC902 Oxoid CM0149 product.
Their exact v4 bytes are awaiting an independent whole-candidate review; this
comment does not record acceptance or application.

The existing native source operator correctly requires a create operation to
have an actual published `new_owner` origin with a null preimage, and prevents
applying one `(worker slot, proposal ID)` twice. W03's original
`b-proposal-cm0149-form` is an edit of the real mixed RCM owner, not a new-product
origin. Its kind or authentic before digest must not be rewritten to bypass that
boundary.

After the independent candidate review and its findings are resolved, W03 should
publish a bounded report-only successor for its original NBRC902 case: a genuine
new Oxoid CM0149 proposal, preserving the original raw label, case hash,
occurrence, primary evidence, old mixed-owner preimage and both author/reviewer
lineages. The old form annotation leaves the active application selection and is
retained byte-exactly as retirement/reconciliation evidence. All other source
cases and payloads require explicit unchanged proof. Publication must identify
the actual coordinator author of the adopted candidate; any changed payload
requires a new independent review rather than a repinned old approval.

The eventual source plan can then use W05's applicable edit origin for the Difco
promotion and the legitimate new W03 product origin for Oxoid creation. The
former W03 mixed-owner annotation remains historical reconciliation evidence,
without becoming a second applied origin or support for Difco identity. No
operator enhancement or guard weakening is required.

The scope remains product-specific: modern IFU composition is not backdated to
the unknown historical lot; no B/T package, historical formula, generic RCM
membership, uncatalogued Oxoid identity, role or release approval is inferred.

Exact pending Oxoid payload SHA256:
`1ec7554da19d5a6ab2259ee79d178a95511a923e611f4fc176af498248ab76ae`.
Original W03 case:
`CM_NAME:2be5d4f231ea346e62be345a8e8b35adbc735ccdced2de73963ce5265c48fd66`;
occurrence:
`CM_OCC:ffcf2b54ee7027b6166807e15a6a72a9bae955a7c8c4576805c5bb8e99196307`.

Original proposals, source captures, reviews and the earlier private candidates
remain immutable. Independent final-head intake acceptance and the native
publication gates still precede maintained application.
